deathSays.line: 📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"

Long muscle, barely a bone in it. Roast it well — and make sure it's actually dead first. It can twitch a shock out for a while after. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Mountain Lord is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

🔥 The fire settles. Barbara has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Xiaoli mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Jorge says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
